mapper.insert: insert into chat_message ( chat_message_no, chat_channel_no, chat_message_sender, chat_message_content, chat_message_type, chat_message_ctime, chat_message_utime, chat_message_deleted ) values ( #{no}, #{channelNo}, #{projectMemberNo}, #{content}, #{type}, systimestamp, systimestamp, 'N' )
mapper.select: select chat_message_no as no, chat_channel_no as channelNo, chat_message_sender as projectMemberNo, chat_message_content as content, chat_message_type as type, chat_message_ctime as ctime, chat_message_utime as utime from chat_message where chat_message_no = #{chatMessageNo}

select M.chat_message_no AS chatMessageNo, M.chat_channel_no AS channelNo, C.project_no AS projectNo, M.chat_message_sender AS projectMemberNo from chat_message M join chat_channel C on M.chat_channel_no = C.chat_channel_no where M.chat_message_no = #{chatMessageNo}
mapper.sql: with temp_list as ( select rownum rn, TMP.* from (
mapper.select:
select M.chat_message_no, M.chat_channel_no, M.chat_message_sender, PM.emp_no AS emp_no, E.emp_name AS sender_name, M.chat_message_content, M.chat_message_type, M.chat_message_ctime, M.chat_message_utime, M.chat_message_deleted,
( select count(*) from project_member PM2 where PM2.project_no = CC.project_no
and PM2.project_member_no != M.chat_message_sender
and not exists ( select 1 from chat_read CR where CR.chat_message_no = M.chat_message_no and CR.project_member_no = PM2.project_member_no ) ) AS unread_count
from chat_message M
left outer join chat_channel CC on M.chat_channel_no = CC.chat_channel_no
left outer join project_member PM on M.chat_message_sender = PM.project_member_no
left outer join emp E on PM.emp_no = E.emp_no
where M.chat_channel_no = #{channelNo}
order by M.chat_message_no desc
select * from ( select * from temp_list
where chat_message_no < #{lastMessageNo}
)
where rownum <= #{size}
order by chat_message_no asc
mapper.update: update chat_message set chat_message_content = #{chatMessageContent}, chat_message_utime = systimestamp where chat_message_no = #{chatMessageNo} and chat_message_deleted = 'N'
mapper.select:
select M.chat_message_no as messageNo,
( select count(*) from project_member PM where PM.project_no = CC.project_no
and PM.project_member_no != M.chat_message_sender
and not exists ( select 1 from chat_read CR where CR.chat_message_no = M.chat_message_no and CR.project_member_no = PM.project_member_no )
) as unreadCount
from chat_message M join chat_channel CC on M.chat_channel_no = CC.chat_channel_no
where M.chat_channel_no = #{channelNo}
order by M.chat_message_no

select C.chat_channel_no as channelNo,
count(M.chat_message_no) as unreadCount
from chat_channel C
left outer join chat_message M on C.chat_channel_no = M.chat_channel_no
and M.chat_message_sender != #{projectMemberNo}
and not exists ( select 1 from chat_read CR where CR.chat_message_no = M.chat_message_no and CR.project_member_no = #{projectMemberNo} )
where C.project_no = #{projectNo}
group by C.chat_channel_no
order by C.chat_channel_no
